Condition NOTE1,2,3,4: NOTE 1:DRX or non DRX requirements apply according to the conditions described in section 5NOTE 3: Lind,gaps is the number of SMTC occasions not available at the UE during TSSB_time_index_irat_cca, where Lind,gaps ≤ Lind,gaps,max.
